Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure
Equipment:
Burner Fuel Oil Pumps
Rotary Screw Pumps
Transamerica Deleval Inc.

Equipment Inspection 
 (I2- M6)
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I2 which must be 
performed every six months , as indicated by M6 in the title block.

The burner fuel oil 
pumps (qty =3 /unit) have
capacity of 8701 L/mint at 3.9Kg/Cm2 and 60C each during normal operation two
P/Ps are in service and the other in stand by the discharge press. of the pumps
is controlled by a control valve, which recirculates the
oil back to the day tank the suction of the burner oil pumps are connected to a
common header the suction header is connected to the day tank the burner fuel
oil pump have a common discharge.

The discharge header of the 
pumps supply the pressure control line and burner oil heaters through the flow
indicator and transmitting station.

The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

This document revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: 
 CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions

Work order must be issued and the
qualified maintenance staff should the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution
marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.

Isolate the circuit breaker of the
rotary fuel oil pumps.

Disconnect electric terminals of
rotary fuel oil motor.

The pump P/P must be isolated
mechanically by closing valve discharge and delivery.

Work to be Carried Out

Check free movement of 
pump shaft.
Check pump bearing temperature and change the oil if needed

Check for abnormal noise and repair the cause of the noise by changing the 
defected parts of pump or motor.

Check pump discharge press. and capacity so inspect the stages of the pump and 
repair or change if needed
Check pump motor alignment or make new alignment.
